meta.title: Dry-Fire Trainer drill library
meta.notes: All pars are seconds per string for dry-fire on a laser target at room distance. Multi-shot strings assume a resetting trigger (laser training pistol or trigger-reset device). Edit freely; run `node tools/validate-drills.mjs` after changes.

units.title: Stress & Decision Making
